description.value: Naughty Nellie's is a neighbourhood fish and chips shop on Shelbourne Street in Victoria offering a wide range of fresh seafood — halibut, cod, ling cod, salmon, prawns, oysters, and scallops — alongside classic British-style sides. The restaurant operates both a takeout counter and a dining room, making it a flexible stop for cyclists who want to eat in or grab food on the go. Homemade chips, coleslaw, and tartar sauce round out a menu built around generous combo portions.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 96m; rack at 100m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is reachable and confirms the business name, phone number, and street address. The postal code in OSM (V8N 3K7) differs from the website's postal code (V8N 5Y1) — the website value is preferred. The website explicitly lists a 'TAKE OUT MENU' section and mentions 'DINING ROOM NOW OPEN', confirming both takeout and dine-in service. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM records V8N 3K7 but the business website consistently shows V8N 5Y1. Website value used as authoritative.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating fish and chips restaurant with an active website, confirmed phone number, and current menu. Clear value to touring cyclists as a takeout and dine-in food stop.

wow_evidence: takeout counter and a dining room ... halibut, cod, ling cod, salmon, prawns, oysters, and scallops
